brief: Holds a project's secrets in one registry, with one governed and audited door through which a value can leave.
detail: Secrets are registered once by name, so the whole credential surface is enumerable and every entry is self-redacting. Reveal applies the actor gate (only an effectful, non-sandboxed actor passes; a language-model actor is refused) and records the attempt in the access log and in the security ledger, by the secret's name and never its value. RotateToFresh renews a value the store owns, and refuses a secret that lives in an environment variable, a file or a vault, naming where to rotate it. SaveSealedTo writes the store as one authenticated-encryption blob, and StzSecretStoreFromSealedFile reads it back. The store keeps a copy of what it registers.
